name: Reina
source:
She's a monster girl who has tried repeatedly to get a human to like her, but has failed each time because of how creepily possessive she is. Being part squid, she's an excellent swimmer, but she has trouble moving around on land. She adores [url=https://vndb.org/c69867]Morgan[/url] as soon as they meet, but he's wary of her behaviour.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/812410/]Steam[/url]]
